messages:
Sam: evening handoff — heads up I'm OOO tomorrow morning. can we confirm APAC coverage and a short async triage window? proposing a 10m check-in at 03:30 UTC. agenda: 1) open Sev2 cache-thrash owner 2) rollout watch for v2 runtime 3) short RCA sync for last night's latency spike

Maria: I can take APAC 03:00-05:00 UTC and pick up the Sev2 if nobody objects. @lee @jon?

Lee: I can cover rollout watch 02:45-03:30 UTC then pass to Maria. leaving my mini-runbook below.

Lee: ```
# rollout watch checklist
- monitor qps / 99p latency dashboards
- watch redis hit rate / eviction rate
- verify model-host pool healthy (ready pods)
- escalation: ping #eng-oncall + call escalation list
```

Jon: I can be escalation liaison 03:00-04:00 UTC. +1 for Maria on Sev2. :thumbsup:

Sam: thanks. @oncall-bot please add Maria to escalation rotation for tonight (APAC window). set reminder 10m before shift. :pray:

oncall-bot: Added Maria to escalation rotation for 2026-03-19 03:00-05:00 UTC. Reminder scheduled 10 minutes prior.

Maria: noted. I'll open a dedicated Sev2 triage thread and post initial findings. planning to grab /metrics and heap profiles first.

Sam: quick ops notes to include in triage thread if needed — if cache-thrash recurs: run `kubectl scale deploy cache-layer --replicas=4` and pause any new rollouts; capture `/metrics` endpoint and redis INFO before scaling.

Lee: copying those commands into my watch bookmarks. I'll enable verbose cache logs at 02:50 UTC.

Jon: ping me once the Sev2 thread is up; I'll join and handle pager escalations if they show up.

Sam: perfect. meeting/hand-off plan confirmed. async check-in at 03:30 UTC, but keep the Sev2 thread active. link for quick bridge: https://meet.redwood.ai/triage-handoff-1965432101

Maria: :rocket: starting the Sev2 thread now.

Sam: thanks everyone, enjoy the rest of the evening.
